targetText: He will be unable to tell me why a certain amount of money is given for a certain amount of labour. If he should answer me, "This was settled by the law of supply and demand," I should ask him, in the first instance, by what law supply and demand are themselves regulated.
explanation: Supply and demand only shifts prices around a centre of gravity: it does not explain what that centre is. To understand why wages settle where they do, you need the theory of value, not just market fluctuations.
